messages:
james: Hey — did anyone actually get paged for the incident this morning? I see a bunch of failed deliveries in inc-bot logs.
inc-bot: automated: delivery failures suppressed, reason=automation_squelch, failed=34, last_error=504, route=/pagerhook
lina: I didn’t get a page. Phone silent :confused:
anya: same here, I'm on-call and nothing. PD shows no trigger for this window.
sre-bot: health alert: inc-bot heartbeat missing (last seen 00:03:12 ago). Investigating.
mike: Checking inc-bot logs now — lots of 429 from pd-proxy: "rate_limit=burst", header X-Route missing. Looks like the router proxy is returning backpressure.
james: If PD proxy is ratelimiting, that could explain auto-squelch kicking in. Kate, can you start manual escalation (phone tree) while we triage? :phone:
kate-ops: Calling oncall now. Manual page succeeded for anya (confirmed). Also created PD incident PD-2468 and added affected accounts.
mike: Running fix attempt: ```kubectl exec -n infra deploy/inc-bot-webhook -- /bin/sh -c "pkill -HUP inc-bot && curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health" && kubectl rollout restart deploy/pd-proxy``` — restarting webhook worker and PD proxy.
inc-bot: system: delivery_retries_exceeded for 34 messages, last_payload_id=gh12-9ab
lina: From metrics: hosted inference latency spiked ~120ms and error rate increased ~1.3% for ~22m. Some requests fell back to lower-tier model; customers saw degraded responses.
anya: Customer impact logged in PD-2468 notes. Notifying the top 3 affected accounts now.
mike: Post-restart: inc-bot heartbeat back. Queue drain: 28/34 processed, 6 retried, 1 stuck due to malformed payload (content-length mismatch).
james: Good. Temporary mitigation: I removed the suppressor rule matching `automation:incident_squelch` so pages aren't auto-muted during proxy instability. We'll revert after fix.
kate-ops: Suppressor removed, test page sent — oncall phone rang at 1708460100 :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: test delivery confirmed.
anya: Follow-ups: (1) add metric for inc-bot accepted_vs_delivered ratio, (2) bump PD proxy burst limit, (3) fix TTL parsing that caused retries to be treated as permanent suppressions.
james: Agree. I'll draft a short postmortem and update the runbook with manual phone escalation steps and the suppressor rollback command.
mike: Leaving a note in ops-runbook: ```# temporary: disable automation squelch
curl -X POST $ADMIN/inc-bot/suppressors/disable -d '{"match":"automation:incident_squelch"}'``` — will clean up the change after deploy verification.
lina: Thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation — will follow up in the postmortem thread. :bow:
inc-bot: automated: resolved flags set, pending=0
